body:
Wires Playwright against the Electron binary and adds a CI-enforced 500 ms mount-time budget for the Movements screen (navigate ΓåÆ first data row visible). Gate runs on `main` pushes only; PR-blocking revisit after one week of data.

## Changes

- **`playwright.config.ts`** (new) ΓÇö root-level config: `testDir: tests/e2e`, 120 s timeout, serial execution (`fullyParallel: false`), 1 retry on CI
- **`tests/e2e/movements-perf.spec.ts`** (new) ΓÇö perf budget gate:
  - `beforeAll` seeds 5 000 transactions via `perf:seed` (deterministic, idempotent)
  - 3 independent Electron launches with `OT_DATA_DIR=perf-events`, `OT_SEED=none`
  - measures click-on-nav ΓåÆ `table.ot-table tbody tr:not([aria-hidden="true"])` visible
  - asserts **median Γëñ 500 ms**; fails CI if exceeded
  - selector is position-based (2nd item in primary nav section) to be stable across i18n locales
- **`tests/e2e/smoke.spec.ts`** ΓÇö removes `test.skip`; now a real test alongside the perf spec (resolves "don't leave both `test.skip` and a real test file" requirement)
- **`.github/workflows/ci.yml`** ΓÇö adds `e2e-perf` job:
  - `if: github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'`
  - `needs: quality`, `permissions: contents: read`
  - builds app ΓåÆ installs Playwright + system deps ΓåÆ seeds data ΓåÆ `xvfb-run npm run e2e`
- **`docs/perf/playwright-gate.md`** (new) ΓÇö budget rationale, tuning guidance (`observed_median ├ù 1.5`), local repro, and debug playbook

## Branch discipline

- [ ] Branched from `main` (trunk-based ΓÇö no direct commits to `main`; see team
      decision 2026-04-19).
- [ ] Branch name follows the convention in
      [ADR-002 ┬º7.1](../docs/architecture/adr-002-repo-structure.md): `feat/ΓÇª`,
      `fix/ΓÇª`, `docs/ΓÇª`, `chore/ΓÇª`, or `sec/ΓÇª`.

## Spec reference

- **Feature spec:** N/A ΓÇö perf gate is a CI infrastructure deliverable specified entirely in issue #39-c
- **PRD (if applicable):** N/A
- **Spec status at merge time:** N/A

> Infrastructure-only change (test harness + CI job). No product spec applies.

## ADR conditions satisfied

- [ ] **ADR-001 conditions:** N/A ΓÇö no production code changed
- [ ] **ADR-002 (repo structure):** test files do not import from `src/main/`, `src/crypto/`, or `src/preload/`; new files placed under `tests/e2e/` per ADR-002 ┬º4 hybrid test layout
- [ ] **Other ADRs:** N/A

## Security checklist

- [ ] No plaintext PII or financial data in committed files or logs ΓÇö N/A (only synthetic seed data)
- [ ] No secrets, keys, tokens, or signing material in the diff ΓÇö N/A
- [ ] AEAD envelope unchanged ΓÇö N/A (no crypto changes)
- [ ] Electron hardening unchanged ΓÇö no `webPreferences` or CSP changes
- [ ] New IPC channels ΓÇö N/A
- [ ] New native dependency ΓÇö N/A
- [ ] New user-entered or imported data path ΓÇö N/A
- [ ] Filenames for encrypted artifacts ΓÇö N/A
- [ ] Switch review requested ΓÇö N/A (no crypto/preload/IPC changes)

## Tests

- [ ] Unit tests added / updated ΓÇö N/A (this PR *is* the test infrastructure)
- [ ] Integration tests added / updated ΓÇö N/A
- [x] E2E coverage considered ΓÇö `movements-perf.spec.ts` is the E2E gate; `smoke.spec.ts` un-skipped
- [x] All lint/format/type-check/test gates pass locally

## Traceability

- [ ] Spec `## Status History` updated with this PR's commit (at merge time) ΓÇö N/A
- [ ] If this PR changes an ADR condition's enforcement, note in the ADR ΓÇö N/A

## Notes for reviewers

- **Depends on #39-a (virtualisation)** ΓÇö without virtualised rows, 500 ms is unmeetable and the gate will fail every `main` push. Merge this only after #39-a lands.
- The `BUDGET_MS = 500` constant and the `RUNS = 3` (must stay odd ΓÇö median formula) are the two knobs to tune post-stabilisation.
- Selector `'.ot-shell__sidebar > div:first-child > ul > li:nth-child(2) > button'` is intentionally position-based; any reordering of the primary nav section will require an update here.
- `xvfb-run` is the standard headless display approach for Electron on Linux runners; `npx playwright install --with-deps chromium` installs the overlapping system deps (libgtk, libgbm, etc.) that both Playwright Chromium and Electron need.
title: perf(#39-c): Playwright perf-budget gate for MovementsScreen mount
